function parseInk(css): [number, number, number]

Defined in: experiments/docs/arch-scene-3d.ts:81

Parses a CSS color string into 0-1 rgb channels — the engine takes raw f32 triplets where the three path passed a THREE.Color. Handles rgb()/rgba() and #rgb/#rrggbb (what getComputedStyle emits); anything else falls back to white — unreachable in real browsers, which always resolve color to an rgb() serialization.

Parameters

css

string

Computed color string.

Returns

[number, number, number]

[r, g, b] in 0-1.
